headline: Trade Ministry Sanctions 15 Business Operators Violating Minyakita Distribution
summary: Indonesia's Trade Ministry has sanctioned 15 business operators for violations in distributing Minyakita, a government-regulated cooking oil brand. No further details were provided.
why: Minyakita is a government-programmed cooking oil sold at controlled prices, so distribution rules affect food companies and retail supply chains.
